Jwt.//Key: REQUIRED — set via env var Jwt__Key (≥32 chars, rotate quarterly)

Admin.//: Set Admin__Password via env var. Email + FullName can stay here.

Email.//: Set Email__Password via env var. SendGrid example: Host=smtp.sendgrid.net, Port=587, Username=apikey, Password=<API-KEY>

DataProtection.//: Multi-instance: point KeyRingPath at a SHARED volume so all instances share the key ring (else cross-instance cookie/antiforgery breaks). Single instance: leave empty → defaults to <ContentRoot>/keys.

Observability.//: Set Observability__OtlpEndpoint to your OTLP collector (e.g. http://otel-collector:4317) to stream traces + metrics. Empty = disabled.

Stripe.//: SecretKey + WebhookSecret env var ilə verilir: Stripe__SecretKey, Stripe__WebhookSecret. Currency Stripe formatında (məs. usd). Canlı üçün pk_live/sk_live işlət.
